notes.title: Standalone Version - Dec 5, 2024 (Thu)
notes.content:
The standalone version is just around the corner!
I hope the past seven years we've spent together become cherished memories in your hearts, ones you'll look back on fondly for years to come. Thank you!

⏱️ Transition Time: Dec 5th (Thu) at 4:00 ~ 5:00 AM ⏱️ 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/0c4e04787f3106dc7f62a9bd4de6dac95b058578.png[/img]

===============================================================================

🚨Update to version v2.61.18 on your device's app store to switch to the standalone version.
🚨Make sure you have enough storage: 2GB for Android or 3.32GB for iOS.
🚨Important: Once this build is released, if you change your device or delete and reinstall the game, your account information will be permanently deleted. Please keep this in mind to avoid losing your progress.

===============================================================================

📍For the standalone version, your existing account data will remain intact, except for specific details such as rankings and guild information.
📍When you create a new account, it will start with all the basic items provided.

===============================================================================

Q. I have multiple accounts on one device and want to switch to a different one.
A. When you first log in, a "Select Account" popup will appear. You can also change accounts later in the settings.

Q. How can I use the standalone version with a new account instead of my existing one?
A. Go to Settings and select "Create New Account." You can switch back to your existing account using "Select Account."

===============================================================================

■ Lobby　 
Enjoy a revamped lobby with menus available just in offline mode. 
Change your lobby settings after watching the final video on the Tavern Board.

■ Profile　
Your details, such as your nickname, account level, and join date, are securely stored. 
Update your nickname and illustration anytime.
The tier will represent your highest ranks in the Arena, Novice Arena, and World Arena based on standings as of 1:00 PM on November 21st (Thu).

■ Campaign　 
Check out Chapter 31 of Season 3 for the finale of Brave Nine. 
Main quests, friend mercenaries, and chat features are removed, and rewards will not be available. 
Formations are expanded up to 40.

■ Free Mode　
A new feature has been added that allows you to arrange mercenaries and monsters for battles freely. 
In Free Mode, you can access Mercenaries, Monsters, Runes, Soul Gear, Insignia of Creed, Costumes, and Spell Cards, regardless of whether you've acquired them.
You can set up opposing formations without restrictions, enabling battles of up to 18 vs. 18.
Additionally, Random Deployment allows you to call upon the decks of top Arena players for battle.
Before setting up your mercenaries, you can adjust settings such as Level, Skill Level, Runes, Soul Gear, Insignia of Creed, and Costumes, and these settings will be applied consistently.
▼ Rune
All types of runes are available based on ★6 Legend Rune+ SSS / Mythic Rune SSS.
Runes will be duplicated and remain in your inventory even when equipped. 
▼ Insignia of Creed
You can choose and set up to five Insignias.
▼ Soul Gear
You can choose and set up to two Amulet options.
▼ Spell Card
Spell Cards can be used in monster battles.
▼ Filter
Provides filtering options for Mercenaries by Star Rank, Normal Monsters, Boss Monsters, White Star, and others.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/f01fff4bb5a7577f0a40f833e7954d514ac4ed29.png[/img]

■ Hall of Fame　
Displays the top rankings for Arena, Novice Arena, World Arena, and Guild War on each server based on data collected until 1:00 PM on November 21st (Thu).
You can view details of top-ranking players or guilds by clicking the “Info” button.

■ Mercenary　
▼ Mercenary
Players with existing accounts will receive all mercenaries from the Book at max level and upgraded to +15, excluding their current mercenaries, and these will be provided in a locked state.
* All mercenaries, including collaboration and fusion ones, are included, except certain White Star mercenaries.
Mercenaries can be locked, favorited, or deleted.
▼ Mercenary Details
You can view the mercenary's Profile, Story, Base Stats, Skills, Companions, Runes, Insignia of Creed, Soul Gear, Costumes, Set Effects, Co-op Attacks, and additional effects.
▼ Companion
Companions are provided fully upgraded to level 5.
▼ Rune
All types of runes are available based on ★6 Legend Rune+ SSS / Mythic Rune SSS.
They can be equipped, unequipped, and replaced as needed.
▼ Insignia of Creed
You can choose five Insignias without spending resources and change them at any time.
▼ Soul Gear
Soul Gear is provided equipped and upgraded to level 25.
You can equip and unequip them as needed and choose two options for amulet refining.
▼ Mythic Mercenary Skill
The first skill is provided at full upgrade level S.
Skills can be reset without resource cost, and chosen skills will appear with a 100% probability when resetting.
▼ Costume
All costumes are provided except for collaboration and limited-sale costumes.
Christmas Granhildr, Christmas Angelica, Christmas Nightmare Celia, Santa Nartas,
Succubus Davi Refithea, Bluffing Demeter Valzé, Equinoctial Bari Hell, AI Carlson, 
Strelitzia Hiro, Delphinium Goro, DJ Venaka

■ Book　
Check out Mercenaries, Companions, Skills, Soul Gear, Set Effects, Co-op Attacks, and Spell Cards.
All Set effects are activated and maintained at level 5.

■ Story　
The final story of Brave Nine is added in Chapter 31 of Season 3. 
Formations are expanded up to 40.

■ Naressa's Study　
Explore conversations between the future Naressa and her assistant.

■ Bag　
View items, gifts, and titles.
All titles, except for temporary ones, are provided.

■ Sleep Mode　
You can now enable Sleep Mode.  

■ Tavern Board　
Posts made on the "Memory Board" by November 15, 2024 (Fri), will be displayed randomly each time you enter the screen.
You can watch the ending video after clearing all of Season 3’s campaign.

■ Memory Book　
Check out comments left by mercenaries for you on the Memory Book.

■ Settings　
You can use features such as Create New Account, Select Existing Account, Select Lobby, and Clear Campaign.
For Clear Campaign, you can instantly clear all campaign stages by pressing the “Clear Campaign” button in the settings.
This will also unlock the ending video on the Tavern Board.

notes.title: Notice: Solo Raid Update and Compensation
notes.content:
During Seasons 19, 23, and 27, we found an issue where reaching a certain score in 'Ecke' made the app crash or hid top players in the Solo Raid lobby and rankings.

As a token of apology, we're giving out 3,000 Diamonds. You can claim this once per account for a week after this notice.
(Available until 11:59 PM on Friday, November 7th)

'Ecke' will be back to normal next season.
We apologize for the trouble this has caused.

Our Brave Nine team is working hard to repay the love and support you've shown us.
We want you to continue loving Brave Nine, so we’re diligently preparing various events as mentioned above.

With this update, please enjoy enhanced Mercenary growth, battles, stage clears, and more.
Thank you!

notes.title: Brave Nine's Transition to Offline Mode
notes.content:
Hello, this is the Brave Nine team.

Thank you for playing Brave Nine. We have some sad news to share. We have concluded that we are unable to maintain Brave Nine's service as it is, and therefore, we have decided to make the necessary changes to make Brave Nine playable in Offline Mode instead. Please refer to the schedule below for more details.

＊ Information about the 8/22 (Thu) update will be provided in a separate future announcement.
＊ The details and schedule for the transition to Offline Mode planned for December will be announced separately once finalized.
＊  The IX Adventure platform will be terminated on Friday, September 13, 2024.

────────────────────────────────────────────────

▼ How to Submit a Refund Request
When: Before the December Offline Mode transition (the exact date will be announced in a future post)
How: Submit your request to the in-game Customer Center or email to mobile@help.pmang.com
Applies to: Paid Diamonds and all In-App Products purchased after Sunday, July 14th, 2024

▼ Required Information
1. Server / Game Member Number / Nickname : (Game Member Number is located in the in-game settings menu)
2. Refund receiving account (Bank Name / Account Number / Account Holder Name) : 
3. Information for each app store purchase (Product Name / Order Number / Email, etc.) : 
4. Phone Number : 

────────────────────────────────────────────────

Due to the changes mentioned above, we will not be able to present you with the Dev Note that was planned for today.

New mercenaries and content will not be added to the game. However, we are currently working on ensuring you can continue to play the game and view your history without a network connection. Please keep in mind that this process may require multiple maintenance periods for data linkage and stabilization before the transition date.

Additionally, we will be providing a fan kit on the brand page. Connect to the link below to download various images used in-game.
https://www.bravenine.com/en/media/fankit

We will do our best to support our Captains during this transition. Thank you for your love and support over the last 7 years.

Take care and best of luck in all your adventures!

Sincerely,
The Brave Nine Team

notes.title: Developer Notes - July 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/06a2276ad73bd029c8a3073f70489c2d7e68e066.jpg[/img]
We've prepared the Developer Notes for June 2024.

■ New Legend Mercenary and Companion
Mercenary Minerva and Companion Arachne will be added to the game and are part of the Legend Group Liberators.

Fallen Creed 'Minerva'
「Humans and dust are alike - both need to be wiped clean now and then.」
The Liberators were individuals from ancient times who embraced corrupted magic, ascending to godlike status.
She was a remarkable general renowned for her exceptional leadership, keen judgment, and power.
Her army was nearly annihilated by humans and the lord she loyally served.
Nearly at death’s door, Minerva joined forces with the Liberators and survived the ordeal.
She now harbors a deep-seated hatred for humanity.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/d358b87901584ae18dbe084f42cb7945bded0624.jpg[/img]

Minerva’s Companion ‘Arachne’
「I don’t care! I’ll do what I want!」
Born to aid with the Liberator's return—the Sacrifice.
Growing by absorbing all manner of seal magic and curses of confinement imposed upon the Liberator.
Among the Liberators' Sacrifices, Arachne stands out as particularly stubborn, unruly, and a constant source of trouble.
Even Minerva, known for her patience with allies and subordinates, finds Arachne challenging to manage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/0d65fb431983338da7bd127d3c15e22e422aded2.jpg[/img]

■ New White Star Fusion Mercenary
Added 7 new White Star Fusion Mercenaries. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/79d4bacfce1049f8702ecf09ae59e9a170dfcc41.png[/img]

■ Mercenary Fusion UI Improvements

notes.title: May 9th Update
notes.content:
■ Maintenance Period: 04:00 - 08:30 May 9th 2024 (UTC). -Total of 4 hours 30 minutes
■ The game will not be available during this period.
■ Details

1. Solo Raid Official Launch and 1 New Boss
Solo Raid's Beta period will end and it will officially launch.
Solo Raid Seasons will start every Thursday at 20:00 (UTC) and it will be available for a week each Season.
The first official Season will start at 20:00 on May 9th 2024 (UTC).
​
On the Official Launch of the Solo Raid Season,
'Bradako with something to say' will appear following the previous 'Crystal Queen Luminous'.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/0bfa7eb9988c86a5b94a84be037a62d2a3f801a5.png[/img]

■ Solo Raid Changes
Skills can now be unequipped in the Training mode.
Maximum Damage limit for each individual Mercenary set to 1 billion.
Fixed an error with the BGM in the combat preparation screen and Skill activation sound now playing properly.
Guide / Score Tooltip Changes: The maximum damage that each Mercenary can deal with '1 billion'.

2. 1 New Exalted Mercenary Added
※ The information below may be different from the live update version.
※ Please refer to the in-game encyclopedia after the May 9th Update for more details.

New Exalted Mercenary 'Ragares' who belongs to the new Exalted Group 'Fatebearer' will be added.

Demon of Fate 'Ragares'
「You want me to defeat Velfern? That shouldn't be too difficult, but... why?」
An ancient demon from the dawn of time. She existed long before the Octo, Liberators, and countless other demons emerged.
She was the demon who led the monsters which the humans, alongside gods, to Allan. 
She was always questioning her own being and identity, which led to the conclusion that she should not exist.
She ended up sealing herself as a result... but after a long time had passed, the 'Pale Demons' resurrected her.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/a5f865af227bd4653430720e3b22393fc39a266d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/131afcddd01008b2ff922a649654d4aad069ebd2.png[/img]

3. 1 New Companion Added
※ The information below may be different from the live update version.
※ Please refer to the in-game encyclopedia after the May 9th Update for more details.

1 New Companion will be added.

Hanya's Companion 'Lanya'
「Hanya, the top swordsman? That's a stretch.」
Hanya and Niya's bigger sister. The firstborn of Hanya and Niya's family. She used to guard a small village on the outskirts of Allan where her whole cat tribe resided.
She shifted her focus from physical to mental training. Eventually, she passed on her title as the tribe's best swordsman to Hanya. 
She once again picked up her sword at Hanya's heartfelt plea after both Hanya and Niya left to join the West Wind Thieves.
She looks quite young for her age and she prides herself on that.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/03ddb90d6ea3e9db78a4004d074b5bdce9e6a1df.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/209c5ff0f6132c18936dd69e4fe9aac2dd43c094.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/6f4d889e3db821a81707cbf719146e8e9fcb1c16.png[/img]

■ New Companion Chance-up Update
- Period: May 9th Update - Jun 13th Update 2024 (UTC).
- Details: New Companion can be recruited at increased rates.
​- Target Companion: Lanya (★5)
​
- How to Use
1) Go to the [Recruit] menu and select the [New Companion Chance-up] image.
​2) Recruit Mercenaries and Companions using Diamonds or Premium Scrolls.
​3) New Companion Chance-up Probability.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/a49eab6ca82ca256964a8e5f8c63def698242dbb.png[/img]

※ New Companion can be obtained from the New Companion Chance-up Recruit.

4. Mini Game: Run Yuridori (Renewal)
Run Yuridori design has gone through a renewal to change the Christmas background into something that fits the warmer weather a bit more.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/902dfa5a2ed78c02839a67b7d1c08b1309d9d2f3.png[/img]

Event Period: May 9th Update - Jun 13th Update 2024
[Mini Game Details]
Use the Jump and Slide button to help running Yuridori avoid obstacles.
Obtain as many items as possible to reach a high score.
(Jumping again while in the air can allow Yuridori to do a double jump).
​
Apple, Mushroom, Meat, and other items can be obtained for a score boost.
Running into obstacles will lower than time limit.
​
Obtaining the Star Decoration will temporarily turn Yuridori into an incinvicible giant.
Obtaining the Heart item will increase the time limit.

When the time limit is reached, the mini-game is over and the final score is recorded.

5. 1 new Costume
Flower Outing Wiriel

Wiriel is in an undercover mission.
She is to watch someone who went out on a flower outing.
She prepared an outfit that doesn't stand out... but she was wrong.
「Hm. This will do. No one will notice me in this outfit.」

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/1d1b94d31256dc286af3ac03d691b7a3af07a47a.png[/img]

In order to renew the New/Returning Captain Support event, this event will no longer be available starting from May 9th Update.

notes.title: Apr 11th Update (7th Anniversary Update)
notes.content:
■ Maintenance Period: 04:00 - 08:30 Apr 11th 2024 (UTC) -total of 4 hours 30 minutes
■ The game will not be available during this period.
■ Update Details

1. New PvE Mode 'Solo Raid (BETA)' Added
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/b756861403b78475e827be68af5c85868aa2a8ba.jpg[/img]
New Challenge Mode: Solo Raid (BETA) will be added.
After the BETA season, we will go over the feedback from our Captains before releasing it officially.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/999df4f2746b6c164049442ec58c99e355fe6c98.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/907117dbaf08d9a2d900f7feed535fd171ba1caf.png[/img]

[Raid Skills]
Solo Raid is a mode where Captains are provided random pool of skills that they can strategically select from to defeat the monster.
All Captains will receive the same 20 skills out of the 26 available. Using specific skills together will unlock a set skill.
Formula for the set skills will be shown on the Set Skill Encyclopedia.
Captains can choose to use 3 skills that do not work a set skill.
It could be a strategic choice to give up on the set skill for 3 skills that are most effective for your build.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/74eca0b27a9316ee066c41df7223c808a9a54d47.png[/img]
There will be a cost to change the selected skill and there is a set limit on how many times a skill can be changed.
We recommend practicing in the Training Center sufficiently before attempting the actual fight .

[Major Rules]
The fight will persist for 3 rounds and up to 9 Mercenaries can be deployed.
The following limitations will be applied
Only up to 1 Mythic Mercenary can be used. (No Limit for Legend/Exalt Mercenaries)
Spell Cards cannot be used.
There are prohibited Skills.

[Reward]
Captains will be ranked depending on the amount of DMG they dealt to the monster for their seasonal rewards.
Rewards will be provided according to the Captains' rankings after the Season ends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/2b81ed8922b7480834c8c08cb66110ef0c02653c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/5dd893fa9bcacf340f8de90809fbb9eac1a57dd4.jpg[/img]

For Captains to ranked #1 on Solo Raid will receive a special limit-time Title.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/ccc329bb2666a6874d4daadf1f0507abf591ac39.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/e144b5bab1f81563984ad89484773d4594c906b7.png[/img]

[Training Center]
Training Center will be available so that Captains can prepare for the battle.
Captains will be able to find the list of bosses that are available to practice.
Raid Skills including the Set Skills can be freely changed in this mode.
Results of the Training Center will not affect the Rankings and Rewards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/180a746e1e8b6843d9d6b334cdff8b6eea81a958.png[/img]

[Schedule]
During the BETA Season, 'Crystal Queen Luminous' will appear.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/ebcc972fb2cad014e77725e9b66036b232403cdb.png[/img]

BETA Season will follow the schedule below.
BETA Season 1: Apr 11th Update - 19:59 Apr 17th 2024 (UTC).
BETA Season 2: 20:00 Apr 24th - 19:59 May 1st 2024 (UTC).

1 new Raid Skill Slot will be unlocked each day after the Season Starts.
Captains will receive 4 chances to attack during the Season. During each attempt a new Raid Skill Slot will be unlocked.
For Example) 
1st Attempt: 1 skill slot unlocked.
2nd Attempt: 2 skill slots unlocked.
3rd Attempt: 3 skill slots unlocked.
4th Attempt: 3 skill slots + set skill unlocked.

Captains who start participating in this mode mid-season will also receive 4 attempts total.
It is even possible for a Captain to join on the last day of the Season to use up all 4 attempts in a single day.

2. New Jump-Start Quest Missions
Jump-Start Quest Round 63 - Round 72 added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/7df87236ff2e34282d5fd399ccee333f282dbd85.png[/img]
These new quest rounds will be available to all Captains including those who already completed all previous 62 rounds and those who have not started the Jump-Start Quest yet.
On the final reward of Round 72, '1 of the 7 Templar Mercenaries' can be selected as a reward. The Mercenary from this reward will be provided as a +9 level 90 Awakened Mercenary.

3. New Costume
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/b7386794b83d06e0f52cd3f3c4d62da39ed9d68f.jpg[/img]
Genderbent Pyran Costume added

Genderbent Pyran
Pyran was tinkering with time, attempting to journey back into the past.
In the process, something went wrong.
However, a mistake of his had disrupted the settings causing changes to his body...

「Ugh... why are the snakes suddenly so clingy?」

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/2440f88e332288fdf5a4874d8efd35006222ae5b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/2e78aea2e7fe375d2f09e2c1f5885397fa10eb29.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/6ad79a6d516548c7884f7a56d4565e768ec294a8.gif[/img]


4. Season Event
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/21c3291a7aed66a17a8f1c51064ed6b0d3e611a6.png[/img]
■ Event Period: Apr 11th Update - May 9th Update 2024
■ Details: Complete 2 missions every day to receive Mercenary Piece, Diamond, Horseshoe, and other various rewards.
​
■ How to Participate
1) 2 new missions will be available every day at 20:00 (UTC).
2) Press the [Collect] button after completing the mission to receive Season Tickets.
3) Each level requires 10 Season Tickets to proceed to the next level.
4) After completing the missions, go to the [Reward] menu to claim the rewards for each completed level.
​
※ Purchasing the Special Season Pass will unlock the Special Season Pass Rewards.
Special Season Pass information is shown under the 'New Packages' part of this announcement.

5. Mini Game: Brave Survival: Carlson's Journey (Updated)
The Mini Game that many of our Captains voted as their 'favorite' is now back!
Try the new Brave Survival: Carlson's Journey with the new balance changes! Attempt to reach a high score!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/b3ef7947fdc84cd598199960fa3386ddaf9560c3.png[/img]

[Mini Game Information]
Drag around the screen to move Carlson.
(On Steam Server's PC Client, Captains can use Keyboard and Mouse to move)
Move around the map and defeat the monsters that show up. Beat the boss monsters, gain exp for levels and items to strengthen your character.
Level-up will provide 3 choices, select 1 to obtain.
(Obtaining the same skill multiple times will strengthen the skill.)

Once the character's HP reaches 0, they will die. If the character does not have resurrect or any form of skills that activate upon death, the mini-game will be over.
Final score will be calculated depending on how long the character survived and how many monsters were killed.

[How to Participate]
- Go to the [Main Lobby] > [Events] > [Brave Survival] to play the mini-game.
There is no requirement or play limit, so enjoy it to your heart's content.
​
[Participation Reward]
While Brave Survival is available, a new Daily Mission 'Play Brave Survival' will be added.
Play the mini game and obtain the daily mission reward.
Daily Mission reward will provide 1 of the following items below.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/d2b4537bc0589053a48f73a142092ad9af6ac341.png[/img]

[Balance Changes]
Characters
All character base movement speed increased.
Item obtain radius increased.
Carlson's Base HP increased.
EXP requirement for early levels decreased (Level-up is faster earlier now)

Stage
Difficulty of late game increased.

Skill Buffs
Axe: Duration increased
Regen: Regen amount increased

6. New Silver Star Mercenary
7th Anniversary Party Yuridori Added
7th Anniversary Party Yuridori will be provided as a gift from 7th Anniversary Gift event.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/861c87437004b352fa01faa8c9436877f014cefc.png[/img]

7. Misc.
When multiple forms of Stone Skin is applied, the strongest (The one that makes the Mercenary take the least amount of DMG) will be applied.
> This is a change that we are making to prevent issues from happening with the Stone Skin skill being added to the Solo Raid.

Underground Arena and Tournament Connection Waiting Period Increased.
> This is a change made to lessen the cases where Captains were losing connection during Tournaments.


8. Bug Fixes
Fate gifts sometimes showing an error when pressing on the gift image for a long time.
Red Dot on the Event Icon not disappearing. 
Ryde's Soul Disturbance Magic not being removed.
Babariba's additional dmg not activating from Mercenary's who were affected by Sylphid Spell Card.

1) 2 new missions will be unlocked every day at 20:00 (UTC).
2) Complete the missions and press the [Collect] button to claim the Season Tickets.
3) Proceed to the next level for every 10 Season Tickets obtained.
4) Go to the [Rewards] menu after completing the missions to claim rewards for each completed level.
​
※ Purchase the Special Season Pass to unlock the Special Season Pass Rewards.
Special Season Pass details are shown below in the New Packages section.

3. Colosseum Required Player Count Decreased.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/f299c6c488fc349a2e0c2e18201a995d7380fce2.png[/img]


4. Bug Fix
1) The issue that was mentioned on the Feb 15th Known Issues
where background repeat battles that ended due to maintenance were not counting towards daily missions and other mission-type events will be fixed.

*Background Repeat set-up before the maintenance that appears to be gone.
>The Background repeat that finished before the maintenance were completed properly. Rewards were provided and points were applied without issues. Unused AP such as Arena Swords were automatically refunded.
>However, when the background repeat ended due to maintenance, the completed battles did not count towards missions and quests such as daily missions.

This issue will be fixed during this update, however this issue will happen once more during the Feb 29th Update as the fix will be applied after this issue occurs.
We recommend manually ending the Background Repeat before the update if you wish for it to count towards your missions.

2) Information text in the Rune Temple sticking out of bounds.

5. Events

3) Use the Alchemy Ingredient to obtain one of the following available rewards.
4) There's a chance for Great / Ultra Success providing more rewards.

notes.title: Feb 15th Update ​
notes.content:
■ Maintenance Period: 04:00 - 07:30 Feb 15th 2024 (UTC). -total of 3 hours 30 minutes
■ The game will not be available during this period.
■ Details

1. 2 New Costumes
Changing Room Supervisor Ulfin and Sailor Uniform Event Lirika Costumes will be added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/e7f1a66afc5d6ea9e768dee98f7b54c32929f59f.jpg[/img]
Changing Room Supervisor Ulfin

Ulfin takes on the night shift duties after a late-night at the office.
As always, she completes the overnight work with minimal room for error.
Now, as she gets ready to change into different clothes in the locker room and head to the sleeping quarters... Someone unexpectedly opens the door.
「Now, should I change into my clothes and get some rest?」

■ How to Obtain: Locker Room Supervisor Ulfin Costume Package

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/53b9db7fb54bd365795b26b7d37785cb46ffcf61.png[/img]
▲Illustration
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/7729c92ed223f2f29a5bedfa26a08d409f78b19e.png[/img]
▲Combat Image
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/421cece961b18ee8f8870f41ab6b4f669f0709f0.gif[/img]
▲Combat Video


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/0c86c2905a73db784340912e4278f7911c29671c.jpg[/img]
Sailor Uniform Event Lirika

Lirika decided to organize a special event for a male friend of hers.
She discovered a particular outfit that is likely to be appreciated to anyone, especially a man.
Despite being different from her usual attire, she brought up the courage to wear it.
「T-take a look... if you want to...」

■ How to Obtain: Sailor Uniform Event Lirika Costume Package
*Lirika's Summon 'Black Knight of Destruction' will not be wearing the Sailor Uniform. The 'Black Knight of Destruction' will have the same appearance as the normal Costume.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/5c50e5b579b6781f97ddcde90ec43baa4f9010d1.png[/img]
▲Illustration
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/a1c9b1b45456a46f539df929d963724472f73c3c.png[/img]
▲Combat Image
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/6dd7eb84994d8b82fdf053a00371a8f2d409b79c.gif[/img]
▲Combat Video

2. Various QoL Improvements

Remove All Button in Formation Settings
On the formation setting or combat screen where Captains can replace the Mercenaries, 'Remove All' feature will be added.
It will make changing the formation a bit more convenient.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/b398a632d0ad6e1b6b3227cb8ac7fe9d96ddebd5.jpg[/img]

Rune Bulk Sell Feature
Bulk Sell feature will be added.
Unnecessary Runes can now be sold in bulk.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/7c4167e06445dcc63d983680110304ede0cbb803.jpg[/img]

Rune Enchant / Refine Animation Skip
Rune Enchant and Refine animation can be skipped and the results will be shown more quickly with the addition of this feature.
Runes can now be enchanted and refined much more quickly, allowing our Captains to prepare for battle much faster.

Rune Enchant
Captains can now skip the Rune Enchanting animation and view the results right away.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/3a02481d551464b504ebee29d31707ad6e6f2d5f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/d7255360e961822e120c6836dba96415e405b55e.png[/img]

Rune Ability Refine
Captains can now skip the Rune Refine animation and view the results right away.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/44e10462df2d6c76b9809f924f3ab17e76f755a9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/39687a34ef4f6e26194849aa6cf38cb4bfb3b779.jpg[/img]

Soul Gear Upgrade / Refine Auto-Repeat and Animation Skip
Soul Gear Upgrade animation can be skipped, and a new feature that will allow auto-repeat until the selected stats are refined will be added.
Soul Gears can now be upgraded and refined for the stats that the Captains want much more quickly, allowing our Captains to prepare for battle much faster.

Soul Gear Upgrade
Upgrade Repeat and animation skip features will be added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/14e679e7fc377d3d660b7d0b7383960c11463b57.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/0e22c4f708da3d62b67fa35d4389108b6bd028bf.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/79d4d41756739c2304ace2cbe36d0701bb128889.jpg[/img]
*The 100% Success item shown on the image is the 'Goddesses Soul Stone' which were provided during Soul Gear refunds for specific Mercenaries in the past.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/b80de8e8e0c2e48e2b4f14c4f7a9a361cc94e35b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/d490b7a00eb72e5e9505e2080a8e58137bf628d9.jpg[/img]

Soul Gear Refine
Captains can now select their desired options and refine will automatically proceed until it reaches the designated repeat count or until the selected options are obtained.
Since Soul Gear Amulets have 2 options, it will stop when 'Both options are the options that were selected'.

Example 1) If the Captain selects 'ATK %' for the option, it will repeat until both of the Soul Gears' options are 'ATK %'.
Example 2) If the Captain selects 'ATK %' and 'Flat ATK' options, it will repeat until one of the following sets of options is obtained.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/ed1bce40c0cca01452f0828e953f6156e24d1924.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/9898a4c787f34b0ab0f81e665e7f23377e6b9b5d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/2d225293833c4e4512a2f0695682ff9a7608c588.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/6b03be5b0aa5e124e0d0d794c1188680af145510.jpg[/img]

- Collect All Encyclopedia Growth Reward / Set Effects Feature
Rewards from the Encyclopedia and Set Effects can now be collected all at once.
This will be especially useful for new Captains who need to collect many different growth rewards from various Mercenaries.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/ccb243660933cc9b6a804f3867f444c35bf31644.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/d9350598cf85747faed7169694d94b7036fa1ada.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/a2900f2efcdd9dfebd4b303581464ffc600593ac.jpg[/img]

Bulk Purchase in Shop Improvement
Captains can now input how many of the items they would like to purchase instead of having to purchase them one by one multiple times.
This will be especially useful for purchasing Arena Swords, Compass, and other AP items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/e45f41e488c7bb3466bb6b28e827ad63b535850a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Developer Notes - Feburary 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/59ec5ba69ea95b0b305edd9691e8b2a0ef8e94fb.jpg[/img]

We've prepared the Developer Notes for February 2024.
Some of the screenshots of the new features we are introducing in this month's Developer Notes are in Korean. This is because they are either still being developed or localized for the Global update.
Thank you for your understanding.

■ Quality of Life Improvements
As we have mentioned in our previous update plans, February Updates will focus mostly on various Quality of Life Improvements.
These QoL improvements were selected from all the feedback and suggestions we received from our Captains.
We hope that the following updates will provide our Captains with a better environment to enjoy the game.
Please refer to the information below for more details.

- Rune Enchant / Refine Animation Skip
Rune Enchant and Refine animation can be skipped and the results will be shown more quickly with the addition of this feature.
Runes can now be enchanted and refined much more quickly, allowing our Captains to prepare for battle much faster.

Rune Enchant
Captains can now skip the Rune Enchanting animation and view the results right away.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/ef331b4dcbf19483fae5f6f1660e337094e44a69.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/7abb56666c9c42f422a4a5b8933b6921a26c42fd.png[/img]

Rune Ability Refine
Captains can now skip the Rune Refine animation and view the results right away.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/fc0fe86aceb459f9a775c986ee29a9367d899ca5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/7dd1aae2cd6d1ad2629fad969c604a17d606bca3.png[/img]

Rune Option Refine
Captains can now select their desired options and refine will automatically proceed until it reaches the designated repeat count or until one of the selected options is obtained.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/ce1e1d4c520f7fcdfa0ce26562be45d92522c148.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/69b73451649a076563f45e7ca2dbd94d891edfca.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/da05fe199b6d8d3e2a651be1973e9751d705c994.png[/img]

- Soul Gear Upgrade / Refine Improvement
Soul Gear Upgrade animation can be skipped, and a new feature that will allow auto-repeat until the selected stats are refined will be added.
Soul Gears can now be upgraded and refined for the stats that the Captains want much more quickly, allowing our Captains to prepare for battle much faster.

Soul Gear Upgrade
Upgrade Repeat and animation skip features will be added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/29831867dcb9b97bdd25dcf438710231985109ff.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/ea8293f4d68323d509ca46652f9828730029c8d3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/0a6fa953f51bdbb589ecf216a12e47623b6e91f4.png[/img]

Soul Gear Refine
Captains can now select their desired options and refine will automatically proceed until it reaches the designated repeat count or until the selected options are obtained.
Since Soul Gear Amulets have 2 options, it will stop when 'Both options are the options that were selected'.
Example 1) If the Captain selects 'ATK %' for the option, it will repeat until both of the Soul Gears' options are 'ATK %'.
Example 2) If the Captain selects 'ATK %' and 'Flat ATK' options, it will repeat until one of the following sets of options is obtained.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/55bf856065784ebe3564e88a9405ab82eeb2c78c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/1d4ab9e8386e25bc3ccdb379e50415e2a35bfde4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/d7e905e4d8f5be36eb057f5058f360fb6c163ca3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/404539caa90ef11dfa0597e3e0ddda239118df97.png[/img]

- Bulk Purchase in Shop Improvement
Captains can now input how many of the items they would like to purchase instead of having to purchase them one by one multiple times.
This will be especially useful for purchasing Arena Swords, Compass, and other AP items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/b73115577ea8a4b6fecf90f49e74dc404d653909.png[/img]


- Collect All Encyclopedia Growth Reward Feature
Rewards from the Encyclopedia can now be collected all at once.
This will be especially useful for new Captains who need to collect many different growth rewards from various Mercenaries.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/2a0168911193707ac82deea574b3053a27a8fc78.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/88a344ba0392a9ab57907a350db415a735a36997.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/a15503d1a990ed404393d200d44c5106119362ac.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/c6d0cdb05d4e78618b87a9218faa82032db7dda2.png[/img]

- Formation Setting, Combat Screen 'Remove All' Feature
On the formation setting or combat screen where Captains can replace the Mercenaries, 'Remove All' feature will be added.
It will make changing the formation a bit more convenient.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/6a8389d6289f986d7227afb320563c15bd98d78b.png[/img]

- Rune Bulk Sell Feature
Bulk Sell feature will be added.
Unnecessary Runes can now be sold in bulk.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/eb5e8bf690859e536e2051e37f2cb4612e241c34.png[/img]


- New Achievements
New Achievements related to Mercenary Army creation will be added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/42d5d857eec4455cdf3de63178bc82e733135a57.png[/img]


Misc.
- Some of the unnecessary Chat Alerts will be removed.
- Remaining Purified Terra amount indicator in Arena, World Arena, Novice Arena, Temple of Guardians, Event Dungeon, and Rune Temple will be removed.

■ 4 New Costumes Added
Here are the images of the new Costumes that will be added in February.

Sailor Uniform Event Lirika
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/d72f4cb03838437d006b569248db6eaf16da7b82.png[/img]

Private Claudia
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/3fd6ad09c7992bda9788f559b3d8a00ba137c2a1.png[/img]

Locker Room Supervisor Ulfin
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/3d4ad11c2ba09fbd81205ae7fde2e498354f223a.png[/img]

Black Leggings Dione
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/2f8b3e9ab1be7789a63e3b6a3420b5f9dbd4c73d.png[/img]

notes.title: Developer Notes – January 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/331d07051f5a9a6bb032382c05fd2b92e8169e97.jpg[/img]
Hello, this is the Brave Nine Team! 
Just like in the year 2023, we will be providing Developer Notes regarding the upcoming updates for 2024.

We've prepared the Developer Notes for January 2024.
Some of the screenshots of the new features we are introducing in this month's Developer Notes are in Korean. This is because they are either still being developed or localized for the Global update.
Thank you for your understanding.

Firstly, we made improvements to the way ‘Repeat Battle’ works as so many of our Captains had suggested.

We will be removing the inconvenience of having to keep the game on in order to play the PvP mode.
We will also be implementing a Skip Feature so that rewards from Challenge modes can be obtained instantly.

Please refer to the details below for more information.

■ ‘Background Multi Repeat’ Improvements in ‘Match’ modes
It is now possible to continue the use of ‘Background Multi Repeat’ in ‘Match’ modes even when the game is not on.
• Improved Modes: Arena / Novice Arena / World Arena / Temple of Guardians 
※ This improvement will be applied to ‘Great Voyage’ in the future as well.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/3be4643cb17eba5acc61741204182a20f365609d.png[/img]

■ ‘Multi Repeat’ upgraded to ‘Battle Skip’ in 'Challenge' modes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/5cf545a0df114a3e73b34f63a04e35989db3938a.png[/img]
• In ‘Challenge’ modes, it is no longer necessary to wait until the battles are finished, instead the rewards for all the repeated battles will be provided immediately.
• Improved Modes: Rune Temple / Crystal Cave / Event Dungeon / Limited Dungeon
• Rune Temple / Crystal Cave
  > Once the designated stage has been cleared, 'Battle Skip' feature can be used any number of times regardless of the 'fastest clear record'.
  >'Fastest clear record' will still show up like before.
• Event Dungeon / Limited Dungeon
  > Once the stage is cleared, 'Fastest clear record' and 'available battle time' will be compared to calculate the maximum number of available battles. Captains can then decide how many battles to 'Skip' within that number to receive rewards.

Battle Skip feature will be available after clearing the specified dungeon at least once. No additional currency other than the currency to enter those dungeons will be required.


Following the Run Yuridori Run from December, a new Mini-game with Carlson will be available.
■ New Mini-Game 'Brave Survival: Carlson's Journey'

Did you enjoy the Run Yuridori Run Christmas Operation Mini-game?

With this Update, we have prepared another Mini-game 'Brave Survival: Carlson's Journey'.

Brave Survival features one of Brave Nine's main Mercenaries, Carlson, who must survive by avoiding the enemy attacks while gathering power-ups.
How long can you survive?

We hope that you'll enjoy your time with Carlson and his Journey.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/b6534f4072db401b25e82a3dc8f0e774bc079fd8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/30f217c1d3c708a34359777b2e5d39fe0a58130d.png[/img]

New 'Exalted' grade 'Destinier' group will be added.
Firstly, we would like to introduce the 4 new Exalted Mercenaries.

■ The First Exalted Group 'Destinier'

New Exalted Group 'Destinier' will be added.

Destiniers are the ones who look over the fates of many dimensions.
They are the 'Administrators' who take care of a specific timeline and make sure the fate of that timeline that repeats itself does not go astray. 
They select 1 person in each timeline and stay with them to make sure they will follow the path that they are meant to.
Here are their background stories and illustrations.


Black Oni 'Ryde'
Destiniers - A group that oversees time and fate, also known as the overseers of fate.
Ryde is in charge of the time period known as the War of Gods, where a massive conflict unfolded between the gods and liberators, marking the first signs of a rift in destiny.
There has never been an issue with the destiny that Ryde oversees, making Ryde a seasoned veteran among Destiniers
「Ugh... Anything fun to do? Probably not. I've already experienced tomorrow anyway.」
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/b139415501449c6deadbb96d760bc14a3cdcffc1.png[/img]


Black Wolf 'Ulfin'
Destiniers - A group that oversees time and fate, also known as the overseers of fate.
The incidient which rebel Fabian assassinates King Altair by mobilizing the forces of the Six Devils, a relatively brief but profoundly significant period called the Day of the Eclipse, is currently being overseen by Ulfin.
Ulfin serves as an aide to the key figure, Fabian, guiding him through the rebellion and assisting him in embracing his own death.
「Fabian, looks like you're going down that path again.」
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/4d7af272948004fa846e47dcbbdb2e5434175874.png[/img]

Black Snake 'Pyran'
Destiniers - A group that oversees time and fate, also known as the overseers of fate.
Originally responsible for the era of war between humans and monsters, where goddesses and Iselok battled Dominus Octo, Pyran relinquished the position to Kali, a recent apprentice.
As a seasoned veteran, Pyran was deployed to the Great Mercenary Era due to signs indicating a significant rift in destiny.
「No sense of duty here. It's just a job, you know.」
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/f1b753bc73d2c58fd20b24dc4b930e26aa99a2f1.png[/img]

Black Wing 'Dione'
Destiniers - A group that oversees time and fate, also known as the overseers of fate.
Originally a Valkyrie who had lost her powers, was chosen by the Destiniers and recently joined their ranks
After regaining strength with the Black Wings, she now lives for the thrill of battle, embracing her past nickname as War Maniac—a warrior reveling in the exhilaration of combat.
「I haven't felt tihs way in a while.」
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/90ddc155a0cdcef8b5e62b9dc265d21a32360422.png[/img]


■ Why did you make the new 'Exalted' grade?

> Our Thought Process

We actually had thoughts about adding the new 'Exalted' grade for a long time.

The 'Legend' grade, which we have been using as the main grade right now, has been around for more than 6 years.
Due to it's long existence, there are now numerous steps that our Captains must take to reach the Legend grade's full strength.
On top of this, there are already so many different kinds of Legend Mercenaries available.
As such, we wanted to make a Mercenary group with a simpler growth requirements for a long time.

The biggest offender to this is the existence of the 'Companions' which is making the growth steps much more deeper.
The fact that newcomers need a long time to understand and get used to the growth system in the game is another thing we wanted to change.

> Couldn't we have just used an existing grade?

Trying to make adjustments or changes to the Legend's growth system would prove to be difficult especially since so many of our Captains are already using them.

Some Captains might say that we could've just used the 'Mythic' grade, but we wanted to make sure that the 'Mythics' stay very rare.
It would be too burdensome to release them multiple times a year like the 'Legends', and it would have too much impact on the  game balance if we were to release too many strong Characters.

Also, Mythics themselves do not have an 'easier' growth system either. So we came to a conclusion that using Mythics for this cause was not the right answer.

In the end, we have decided that a new grade which somewhat resembles to the existing grade while also lessening the burdens of growth was necessary.


> 'Exalted' Grade - familiar, but less burdensome.

As you can see from the chart above, 'Exalted' grade's biggest difference from the 'Legend' grade is their lack of Companions.
With this, their growth depth will be much less complex compared to the existing Legends.

The other growth steps will be similar to the 'Legends' so that it will not be difficult to get used to their growth system if you are already playing Brave Nine.

The main goal we have for the 'Exalted' grade's balancing are as follows.

1) Their power level when first obtained should be at least 'Usable right away'. 
Exalted Mercenaries were balanced around being useful even at low skill-up levels, so that the burden of growth would be somewhat alleviated.

2) Brave Nine aims to provide fun of setting up strategic formations using the Exalted Grades.
Many of our Captains would say that the strategic elements are the biggest strength of Brave Nine. 
We wanted to put more emphasis on this strength with new 'Tactics' available from the Exalted grades.
Using 'Exalted' Mercenaries along with the existing ★5 / Legend / Mythic Mercenaries, Captains will have much more tools available for various new strategies.

> But what happens to Legend and lower grades?

While it might be obvious, we will continue to make updates to ★5 and Legend Mercenaries.
There are still ★5 Mercenaries that have not received their Companions yet, and there are new Legends that will need to be added as more story unfolds in the Campaign.

★5 / Legend / Exalted will be updated in turns with some time inbetween, this will not be something you will need to worry about.
Also, we will update a new Mythic Mercenary when the time seems right after deep consideration of the game balance.

The main goal of the Exalted Mercenaries is to 'lessen the complexity of the Mercenary growth while improving the strategic elements'.
Instead of simply replacing the existing Mercenaries, we are preparing a way for various different Mercenaries to be used so that our Captains can enjoy a bigger variety of strategic fun.
We hope you will look forward to our future updates regarding this as well.


■ What differences do 'Exalted' Mercenaries have compared to others?

Major differences of the 'Exalted' grade compared to 'Legend' and 'Mythic' are as follows.

1) The Diamond cost and Guaranteed Recruit count is very similar to the existing Legends.
2) Skill-up, Scrolls, Rank Boosting will require the same grade of materials.
  Growth items can be obtained using the existing currencies so that Captains do not need to farm for a new 'Exalted-exclusive currency' to obtain growth items for the Exalted Mercenaries.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/5142d5a7c521a61deed9649dcb8a57fad6a4c1e3.png[/img]

> With the addition of a new Grade, more materials for existing grades will be provided.

With the addition of the 'Exalted' grade, existing '★5', 'Legend', and 'Mythic' grades will be easier to obtain than before.
Existing Rewards were changed / improved, and more events will provide these items.

With this, we will make sure that the Captains who return to the game after a long absence or newly starting Captains will be well-supported in terms of quick early growth so that they can join the fun of competing against others sooner.

• Jump-Start Quest Improvements
  > ★5 / Legend Mercenaries and Companions as well as their growth items will be increased in Jump-Start Quest
  > Mythic Mercenary-related materials will be added to the reward pool.
  > Major rewards will be improved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/00d463978bd8dc0f5158dc2601f3688e1380d26d.png[/img]

• Reward for each level will be improved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/d9b6bbb3f90b79fe60b5f2b3bd761d5f50a8b4cb.png[/img]
•  Check-in Rewards Improved
  > ★5 / Legend Mercenaries and Companions as well as their growth items will be increased in 28-Days Check-in Rewards.
  > Mythic Mercenary-related materials will be added to the reward pool.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/82eddaae90b16523d92e17b425da6310b6943658.png[/img]
• More Products in Shops
  > Honor Shop / Mileage Shop / Guild Shop / Mystic Island Trade Post / Great Voyage Trade Post
Additional ★5 / Legend / Exalted / Mythic growth materials will be available.
(Details will be included in the January Update Announcement)

The details above may be different from the Live Update version.
Please make sure to refer to the Jan 11th Update Announcement for more details.

■ 2 New Costumes
Here are the illustrations of the 2 new Costumes that will be added in January.

• Red Slime Queen Anna
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/37f543133e3e56bc36ac142c35f3a7e2248ed62b.png[/img]

• Captain Diane
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/a29b1a49e470d4b0da84ddaa3d735c822a44caf4.png[/img]


■ Director's Letter

Hello,
I'm Brave Nine's PD Juseon Seok.

I communicated with our Captains via Videos before, but this is only the second time I write to you via a letter. The first one being from the last December.
In the future, I will do my best to provide more letters or videos to communicate with our Captains more often.

When this Dev Note is available, our 2023 end-of-the-year video (Which I'm also a part of) will be available as well.
We hope you'll watch and enjoy the video as well.
At the end of the video includes details about the gifts and Coupon Codes, so don't miss out!

How was the year 2023 for you, Captains?
The year 2023 has been a very busy and hectic year for the Developer team and I.

New Collaboration, Mythic Mercenary Growth Improvements, Steam Launch, Temple of Guardians, Spine Animations
Pirate Yuridori, Run Yuridori, and other events... We worked hard to provide new fun experiences to our Captains.
We did our best to respond to errors as soon as possible and communicate to our best abilities.
We hope that the efforts and heart that we put into the game had reached our captains.

Recently, the Developer team has been working on a major update that we haven't had in a while.
The information we shared on this Developer Notes may come to a surprise to some of our Captains,
and we are worried that some Captains may view it in a different way than what we had intended.

We would like the year 2024 to be the year where Brave Nine can show off that we have changed.
We will provide a convenient gameplay experience by lessening the fatigue that was caused by various aspects of the game, so that the Captains can focus more on the strategic elements of the game.

In order to achieve this, we will continue to update various Mercenaries and Companions.
We will also add a new Challenge Mode (PvE) content that so many of our Captains had been asking for.
Also, for a more convenient gameplay experience, we will be making improvements to the growth-related animations so that it can be shortened.
We have added a First/Second Half update plans at the end of this Developer Note.
We hope you will look forward to all the things that we will update in 2024 as well.

Lastly, to end off 2023 in a meaningful way to our Captains,
we have prepared the Brave Nine Awards video and gifts.

Cheers to all our Captains who will be receiving the awards!

And great thanks to all our Captains who watched the video and enjoyed Brave Nine whether or not they have received the Brave Nine Awards.

The only reason that we were able to come this far was because of all our Captains who showed their affection to the game.

We will continue to heed our Captains voices',
so that we can remove the aspects of the game that caused inconvenience, and provide a better gaming experience.

We will do our best to provide the Brave Nine that's always fun to play.
We hope you'll stay with us through the new year 2024 as well.

Happy New Year!
Thank you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/917329743a09569e70750480957f40b7f167fa94.png[/img]

notes.title: Regarding the Nov 1st Errors
notes.content:
[h2][Gate of Chaos Error][/h2]
Firstly, we apologize for the inconvenience this error has caused you.
Between 15:00 - 20:00 Oct 31st 2023 (UTC),
Gate of Chaos could not be played normally due to an error.

Similar errors have been happening in the last few months.
While the outcome and the ocurring time is similar, we found different issues causing this problem.
Replicating the exact situation on the test environment was proving to be difficult which caused continued occurrence of similar errors back to back.
This time, however, we were able to replicate the exact issue on the test environment and confirmed that the issue has been fully resolved.

We have prepared the following Compensation for the Captains who were affected by this issue.
Please refer to the details below for more information.

[h2][Battle Pass Error][/h2]
Additionally, there was an issue where opening the Battle Pass menu will show an error and crash the game.

This issue started from 15:00 Oct 31st (UTC) and was fixed by 02:00 Nov 1st (UTC).
We have taken necessary measures to make sure that this will not happen again in the future.
We apologize for the inconvenience these issues have caused you.

notes.title: Developer Notes – November 2023
notes.content:
Hello, this is the Brave Nine Team! 
We've prepared the Developer Notes for November 2023.
Some of the screenshots of the new features we are introducing in this month's Developer Notes are in Korean. This is because they are either still being developed or localized for the Global update. Thank you for your understanding.


[h1]■ New Legend Group ‘Liberators’ added.[/h1]
Six Devils, Dominus Octo, Personaz, and Templars. The new Legend Group to come after them are the ‘Liberators’.
Long long ago, a group of people absorbed the corrupted mana to become closer to gods. They were sealed on the other side of the dimension after losing to the goddess Norjeya
By using the ones that they call ‘Sacrifice’, someone successfully revived them.


[h1]■ 2 New Legend Mercenaries and 2 New Legend Companions.[/h1]
Mercenaries Diane and Venus who belong to the ‘Liberators’ will be added. Their companions ‘Taeon’ and ‘Psyche’ will also be added. 

[h3]Corrupted Moon ‘Diane’[/h3]
In the ancient times, a group known as the ‘Liberators’ received the corrupted mana to be closer to being gods.
She was once a protector of a forest, but she stood against the gods and ended up becoming one of the Liberators.
She’s the owner of the Lunar Bow which can pierce through anything. She lives only for combat and training.
She vowed to keep distance from love and any other earthly desires to receive the pure powers of the moon.
「To pull on the bowstrings. To aim at the enemies. Everything other than these are impure.」

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/93acb9369e3a4322d2e574ae122322400100ee3f.png[/img]

[h3]Diane’s Companion ‘Taeon’[/h3]
Beings born to assist with the Liberators’ revival, ‘Sacrifice’.
They grow up eating all sorts of punishments that befell on the Liberators such as the Sealing magic and various curses.
Once they turn 11 years old, their death can lead to complete revival of the Liberators. 
He’s always happy and optimistic. His optimism can sometimes cross the line and he is always excited no matter what the situation.
「Hurray! It’s raining! I’m so happy! I’m so excited!」


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/826e7f07914c02ea88439e330bb17501159db122.png[/img]

[h3]Corrupted Love ‘Venus’[/h3]
In the ancient times, a group known as the ‘Liberators’ received the corrupted mana to be closer to being gods.
Long ago, they were defeated by the goddess Norjeya and were sealed on the other side of the dimension. They were successfully revived in the current times. 
She possesses truly beautiful looks and has the power to absorb the essence from those who fall for her beauty. 
As such, she always thirsts for more love.
「Aah, how rude...♡」

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/b257f179889e224043e4e894b86ac297e28e2120.png[/img]

[h3]
Venus’s Companion 'Psyche '[/h3]
Beings born to assist with the Liberators’ revival, ‘Sacricice’.
They grow up eating all sorts of punishments that befell on the Liberators such as the Sealing magic and various curses.
Once they turn 11 years old, their death can lead to complete revival of the Liberators.
She really likes Venus and would follow her everywhere, but she’s upset at her for constantly being left alone.
「Hmph! So, very, HMPH! 」

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/da34193ece7f6d0323ac612433fed9dddfd05866.png[/img]




[h1]■ Campaign Part III Episode 5 Added[/h1]

Story about the other group who were sent back to the past as well as
Lain’s story about facing the monsters in a different location at the time.
Captains may briefly see the beliefs that Lain, the leader of the Templars and the Prince, lives by in this campaign.


[h1]■ 4 Mercenary Renewal[/h1]
4 Mercenaries were chosen to be renewed, their renewal direction is as shown below.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/8be452cf9288a6a1203cedcced1d14538a2d27fa.png[/img]

        
※ The renewal directions mentioned above may be different from the Live Update version.

[h1]■ 2 New Set Effects Added[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/9a17d830ddfcc236835361c8569249c3e11a8d3b.png[/img]

[h1]■ New Great Voyage Monsters Added[/h1]
Enemies that Captains may have seen in the Campaign such as ‘Krakenya, Rakenaya, and Kardis Pirates will appear in the Great Voyage

There’s a chance to encounter them during the Clear and Cloudy weathers.

[h1]■ 2 New Costumes Added[/h1]

Lastly, here are the rough images of the new costumes that will be added in November for ‘Agni’ and ‘Porin’.

notes.title: Oct 26th Update
notes.content:
[b]■ Maintenance Period: 04:00 - 10:30 Oct 26th 2023 (UTC)
■ The game will not be available during this period.
■ Details[/b]

[h1]1. Genderbent Iselok Costume[/h1]
​
Genderbent Iselok

Iselok fought against a Succubus from the Night World.
Although he was victorious, he received the curse of the succubus.
He didn't think too much of it... but some changes started showing on his body the next day.

「I did not allow that much. Don't covet too much.」
​
■ How to Obtain: Special Season Pass Reward
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/b6497b87f21f189f779df3b4d7374f28117d7929.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/e88cda7d60e0597ff013173473cdcb485cb88a98.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/4180679cc78c6bc329eed0f30d0f5348f727ec87.gif[/img]


[h1]2. Season Event[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/53ea099c3e738a282893850372577966f7d9aa85.jpg[/img]
■ Event Period: Oct 26th Update - Nov 23rd Update 2023 
■ Details: Complete 2 new missions every day to obtain Mercenary Piece, Diamond, Horseshoe, and other various rewards.
■ How to Participate
1) 2 new missions will become available every day at 20:00 (UTC).
2) Press the [Collect] button after completing the mission to claim the Season Tickets.
3) Progress to the next level by obtaining 10 Season Tickets.
4) Go to the [Reward] menu after completing the mission to claim the rewards for each level.
​
※ Special Season Pass Rewards can be obtained after purchasing the Special Season Pass Product and then completing the missions.
​

[h1]3. Temple of Guardians(BETA)[/h1]

[h3][Background][/h3]
Stadione, a Valkyrie who loves the battlefield and combat.
In search of a more thrilling battle, she ended up finding the Guardians Stones in one of the Sky Islands.
​
Stadione got an idea to make use of these Guardian Stones in battle and started working on it right away.
In order to experience a more glorious battle, she put up a huge reward for the humans who participate in this new battlefield.

[h3][Brief Information about the Game Mode][/h3]
There are 2 available Guardian Stones (Radiant / Bloody). Captains can select 1 to place in their formation.
Radiant Guardian Stone will protect the allies while Bloody Guardian Stone will disrupt the enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/e48305938068ca3beb4e95f6d429ce656d13531a.png[/img]
The side that destroys the enemy Guardian Stone or wipes out the enemy team first wins.
Place the Guardian Stone that suits your formation before participating in battle.
​
While the Guardian Stones have innate defensive skills, they can easily be destroyed if not properly protected.
The combat will work automatically similar to the Arena.

[h3][Available Period][/h3]
Combat will be available for 1 week during each month.
The Temple of Guardians BETA Season will follow the schedule shown below.

- BETA Season: Oct 26th Update - 03:00 Nov 9th 2023 (UTC).
- BETA Combat Period: Oct 26th Update - 12:59 Nov 2nd 2023 (UTC).
- BETA Result Calculating Period: 13:00 Nov 2nd - 15:00 Nov 2nd 2023 (UTC).
- Result Available Period: 15:00 Nov 2nd - 03:00 Nov 9th 2023 (UTC).

[h3][Participation Requirement][/h3]
Complete Campaign Part I Chapter 20-10

[h3][How to Participate][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/80a98c9e3e88cd070d82cda1987bed987214b73e.jpg[/img]
When first entering the Temple of Guardians, Stadione will guide you to make your formation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/e89a8aa3c74f256d10171fd8a9477036c21519ec.jpg[/img]
For the Temple of Guardians formation, 10 Mercenaries and 1 Guardian Stone can be deployed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/c1a180a4e5864ee096161422738ddad39b8f87a4.jpg[/img]
Guardian Stone MUST be placed in your formation.

Temple of Guardians uses AP called the Temple Keys.
Up to 20 Temple Keys will be charged every day at 20:00 (UTC).

Additional Temple Keys can be purchased at the Shop.

[h3][Battle Reward][/h3]
Depending on the results of the Temple of Guardians battle, Honor Point, Battle Point, Purified Terra, and Ancient Succession Log can be obtained.
※ Battle Point can be used for the Temple of Guardians BETA Battle Pass.

[h3][Season Result Reward][/h3]
Participate at least once during the Season to receive the Season Rewards.

Top Rank 1 - 10 Captains will receive a special Temple of Guardians Title.
On top of this, ★6 Rune Piece x250 Selection Tickets and Honor Points will be provided depending on the rank.

Also, the special Title can only be used for a set duration.
When equipping the new Title, a new 'Nameplate' system will be applied which will decorate the Captain's Name.
* Nameplate available period can be viewed in the Lobby > Misc. > Bag > Title menu.

Nameplate will be applied to all content where the Captain Name is shown.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/173072712fdfbb36963aac72870118aebd3bd9d0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/1d49937fd426e3b2b3512d2e19d6d2dc8f9de306.jpg[/img]


[h3][Temple of Guardians Achievements][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/81fae5089fb8e701895558d0df18b3656f2d3dba.png[/img]

[h3][Temple of Guardians Battle Pass][/h3]

Play in the Temple of Guardians to obtain Battle Points.
Claim 'Season Rewards' and 'Special Rewards' from the Battle Pass.

Any Captain who participated in the Temple of Guardians can receive the 'Season Reward',
'Special Rewards' are only available to Captains who purchased the Battle Pass.

* During the Temple of Guardians BETA, all Captains who participate in the Temple of Guardians can purchase the Battle Pass for 100 Gold.
* After the official Launch, 'Special Rewards' will be sold as an In-app Purchase.

Battle Pass is only available for purchase during the 'Temple of Guardians' Season, it cannot be purchased once the Season Closes.

The rewards can be claimed for 7 days after Temple of Guradians Season Closes.
The rewards cannot be claimed after that.

Obtained Battle Points will reset when the next season starts.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/95445f7241428c0505648dcf6f3036a6afc76a8e.jpg[/img]

[h1]4. Mercenary Renewal[/h1]

notes.title: Developer Notes – October 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/09d3072ae5f8eb99cfd3cd849788e69bac18c38d.png[/img]

[h2]■ 2 New Companions[/h2]
2 new Companions will be added.


[h3]Walya’s Companion ‘Porin’[/h3]
「Gramps? Good job! You’re a good boy! Compliments, tada!」
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/fdfa82f06b21145f96a6f2d6a5068941df1ed9d7.png[/img]
Member of the Snow Rabbit Tribe who lives in the Northern Sbern on top of the highest snowy mountains. Born with a naturally strong body, she was given the role Captain of Defense for the whole Beast Tribe from Walya. She’s quite lively and kind, but tends to treat everyone like little kids despite their age.


[h3]Rafina’s Companion ‘Chichi’[/h3]
「Big sis Rafina! Let’s play mental arithmetic’s! 」
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/c5d7b1d05d6cb56ddc82c18aa431d860979cc1ae.png[/img]
Genius little girl who competed against Rafina in the Weapon Engineering Competition for the Champion Spot.
After losing to Rafina, she started following Rafina in her travels.
Despite having the brains of a genius, she’s just an ordinary little kid when it comes to everything else.



[h2]■ New PvP Mode: Temple of Guardians[/h2]
New PvP Mode Temple of Guardians will be released.
It will be available as ‘Beta’ version during the month of October to receive feedback from our Captains.
More details about this mode will be available in the October Update Notes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/b30beaab62942fef2e4fb2131f39313fe76289a6.png[/img]

[h3][Temple of Guardians Lobby Background][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/d33b8e3f783cd76a6b6c807fdb20171fabb26a13.png[/img]

[h3][Temple of Guardians Background Information][/h3]
Stadione, a Valkyrie who loves war and combat.
She was looking for more and continuous exhilarating combat and ended up finding a Guardian Stone on the Sky Islands.
She came up with an idea to use this Guardian Stone for combat and started working on it right away.
In order to experience a higher quality and fancy combat, she set up a huge reward for the participating humans, and a new battleground was born. 

[h3][How Temple of Guardians Combat Works][/h3]
There are 2 types of Guardian Stones: Radiant Guardian Stone and Bloody Guardian Stone. One of these 2 Guardian Stones can be selected to be deployed.
Radiant Guardian Stone has the effect to protect allies while Bloody Guardian Stone has the effect to disturb enemies.
Destroying the enemy Guardian Stone or wiping out the enemy team first will lead to victory.
Use the Guardian Stone that better fits your team for combat.
While the Guardian Stones have innate defensive skills, it can easily be destroyed if not protected which will lead to defeat.
The combat will be automatic similar to the Arena.

notes.title: FAQ
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/e4d4d562fa927684ee5cb97d2689ec758e0ceb86.png[/img]

[b]1. What is Brave Nine?[/b]

▶ Brave Nine is a strategic turn-based battle game featuring over 300 unique Mercenaries presented in stunning artwork. Create your own unique formations, challenge other Captains and engage in decisive combat in tons of modes.


[b]2. When will Brave Nine be released on Steam?[/b]

▶ Expected launch date: August 31, 2023


[b]3. Is the game free to play?[/b]

▶ Yes! 


[b]4. Is crossplay supported between mobile and Steam?[/b]

▶ No, crossplay is not supported. It is a new "Steam Server" for our Captains.
Crossplay between Steam and Google Play Games (PC) is also not supported.


[b]5. Can you play the game from everywhere?[/b]

▶ Yes, but there are some country restrictions:
[list]
[*] Netherlands
[*] Belgium[/list]
[b]6. Will there be any differences between the mobile and Steam?[/b]

▶ You will be able to enjoy all the same features as mobile Brave Nine, except for the Jump-Start Quest and Steam Exclusive Packages.


[b]7. What languages are available in-game?[/b]

▶ Korean, English, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese.


[b]8. How can I change the language in-game?[/b]

▶ [Game Settings] > [Language]


[b]9. Where can I submit 1:1 Inquiry?[/b]
[list]
[*] [Game Settings] > [Customer Center]
[*] Please send us an email through Brave9help@neowiz.com
[/list]

notes.title: Brave Nine 101 : World
notes.content:
[h1]【WORLD】[/h1]

[previewyoutube=7mQqbUqMuq0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/f349a74fa5bd4dac145fdf256ec33fa2f5069cf1.png[/img]

[h2]SBERN[/h2]
Sbern was formed by the group of people from small nations. They tried to create their own force apart from the Karian Empire. However, Sbern is actually divided into two groups, the Federalists and Anti-Federalists. Federalists are willing to form a united force of their own while the Anti-Federalists are planning to take over power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/07a5e2f2988905223a4dccff81e270afbc81dd2d.png[/img]

[h2]ALLAN[/h2]
After Altair II had been murdered, surrounding nations have joined together as 'Allan Alliance' to never be conquered by other nations. Allan Alliance has been divided into Hawks and Doves. Hawks believe that Allan's essence is the strength and that Allan should defeat enemies by force. Doves on the other hand want to cooperate with neighboring countries by communications and persuasions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/98b76a2ffd493627a602b110dde37d0e5b786dfc.png[/img]

[h2]KARIAN[/h2]
Karian Empire was originally ruled by Altair II but after his sudden death, his daughter Iserna, ascended to the throne as the young Empress. With the help of her servants and knights, Iserna is trying to regain the glory of the past. While, the Arclight Order also resides within the Karian Empire and uses its force to punish enemies in the name of god.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/cb28567f60e09ea3b4475f8fea1268124933eb77.png[/img]

[h2]RIAN[/h2]
Rian Republic is divided into two groups, the Republicans and the Royalists. Republicans are the leaders who've founded the Rian Republic and they aim to break down the monarchy and build a democratic country. Royalists believe that King is still needed so they support Slein, who is the descendant of Iselok, to be on the throne.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/fa3d51fadf65a6f7785bd092aafb5fe659477932.png[/img]

notes.title: Brave Nine 101 : System
notes.content:
[h1][GAME MODES][/h1]

[h2]Arena[/h2]
Challenge other Captains from around the world. 
Climb up the ranks to earn a spot on the leaderboards and claim your rewards at the end of every week!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/8ab51cf4f300750121942be01d8762d689c77efd.png[/img]


[h2]Guild War[/h2]
Team up with other Captains and compete in a contest of strength among guilds. 
Carefully plan your defense and launch an organized attack to bring down the opponent guild!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/2fc7a92a80b9fe3c1dc840638836063dd8af4e2b.png[/img]


[h2]World Boss[/h2]
Fight formidable Boss monsters along with other Captains. 
Create the most destructive formation in a Hunt or safely escort your team with minimum damage in Transport!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/04496928d93ba3b7275db81633a82521ed99ee2a.png[/img]


[h2]Campaign[/h2]
Unravel the mystery behind the fall of the Empire. 
With over 1200 stages to clear, experience the rich world of Brave Nine and its unique cast of characters!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/30b8c2f7f4bd1bc077af90c91ec45eb1c0e7b70c.png[/img]


[h2]Evil Castle[/h2]
Ascend to the top floor of the demon-filled castle. Push your brain to the limit and clear fun challenges in each floor to earn an assortment of rewards!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/b01d2f32c692a2c7117e1c6c218f0ac2d3f5b868.png[/img]


[h2]CO-OP Raid[/h2]
Form a party with other captains to defeat powerful enemies. 
Take down the enemy within the time limit with your combined might and collect rare Soul Gear!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/aebb2a040bfc25a49af50bdd1b77f9f23acdcbf8.png[/img]


[h1][CREATE YOUR TEAM WITH 4 CLASSES][/h1]

[h2]DEFENDER[/h2]
Defenders have high HP and DEF.
They are armed with skills that withstand enemy attacks and protect allies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/36de3a631f82f37dda2b22c1c83460fa3f639d3e.png[/img]


[h2]WARRIOR[/h2]
Warriors specialize in attacking the enemy.
They can penetrate the enemy's defense and eliminate threatening Mercenaries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/e91a0845cb55880c8a72e01e7704ea98100fc48e.png[/img]


[h2]SUPPORTER[/h2]
Supporters cast buffs on the next ally to attack.
They give the turn over to the ally they support instead of an enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/1f317e7599685d3cae185451ebea3c989ed862ac.png[/img]


[h2]MAGICIAN[/h2]
Magicians specialize in AoE attacks.
Especially effective in obliterating clusters of enemies and weakening threatening targets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/fb2007a345eb4c946d0d80e33d9df4e7d017347e.png[/img]

[h1][BUILD YOUR MERCENARY][/h1]
Level up your Mercenaries and awaken them to their full potential 
to unleash a new form and enhanced skills!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/05eb78a6b8f36b1e9c54d189376529f0310d107d.png[/img]

[h1][EQUIP UNIQUE COSTUMES][/h1]
Spice up the look of your characters by equipping amazing costumes
with beautiful illustrations!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/f03e6a3ae870a7761e5500aaedb5d5b1883aed1b.png[/img]

[h1][MEET YOUR COMPANIONS][/h1]
Intertwined by fate, discover unique companions for each Mercenary
to further boost their skills and take part in battle!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/699d0e7744689398b61a22a3be3d2093466bfc2d.png[/img]

[h1]CREATE THE ULTIMATE TEAM[/h1]
Create unique formations suited to each challenge with an endless number of combinations to build. Use multiple supports to deal devastating damage or form an impenetrable defense.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/0b479c5eb2c748cf0961e2e027204e6933be548a.png[/img]

notes.title: Introducing Brave Nine(Steam): Experience the Mobile Game on a Bigger Screen!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161215/28a10ede7091f2711cb19c288c7ace5bac82ea2b.png[/img]
We're thrilled to announce the release of Brave Nine on Steam, bringing the beloved mobile gaming experience to your desktop! 
Now, you can delve into the familiar world of Brave Nine with all its original content, but on a grander scale. 
Get ready to immerse yourself in the captivating gameplay and engaging storyline, now optimized for a larger screen and enhanced PC performance.

Key Features:
- Identical Content: Enjoy the same thrilling gameplay and beloved features that made Brave Nine a hit on mobile devices.
- A Bigger Screen, Better Experience: Immerse yourself in the enchanting world of Brave Nine on a larger monitor, revealing every detail and enhancing your overall gaming experience.
- New Dedicated Server: Play Brave Nine on a fresh dedicated server, connecting players from around the world. Compete, cooperate, and forge new friendships with fellow Captains.
- Improved Performance: With the power of PC hardware, Brave Nine(Steam) delivers smoother gameplay, faster loading times, and optimized graphics, allowing you to truly appreciate the game's captivating visuals.

Relive nostalgic memories or embark on an entirely new adventure as you explore the vast landscapes, engage in thrilling battles, and unravel the rich lore of Brave Nine.

But that's not all! We're excited to announce that we will be hosting a special playtest for Brave Nine(Steam). 
It's your chance to get a sneak peek and be among the first to experience the game on PC! 
The playtest will take place next week, and we'll be announcing the Playtest date and time next week.
Mark your calendars and get ready to embark on this thrilling adventure ahead of everyone else!

Spread the word among your friends, guildmates, and fellow Captains. 
Invite them to experience the classic mobile game in a whole new light and discover the wonders of Brave Nine on PC.

Stay tuned for more updates, events, and surprises in the future.
We can't wait to see you all in the world of Brave Nine!

Wishlist us on Steam, visit our official website and join our vibrant community on Discord to stay up to date with the latest news and connect with other players.

Thank you for your continued support, and we look forward to embarking on this thrilling adventure with you!

Brave Nine Operations Team
